hero.title: Anime nights, socials, and community on campus

clubDescription: A society formed by students with a passion in anime/manga that has continued to run exciting events both online and in-person. We’re always giving away prizes for competitions and giveaways so stay tuned!! We’ve grown into one of Sydney’s biggest anime clubs! Memberships are open to anyone, as we strive to gather students interested in anime/manga to socialise and form friendships.
eventsOverview: Expect a full seasonal lineup: watch parties, social mixers, tournament-style competitions, cosplay spotlight nights, and opening-song competitions.
sponsorPerksOverview: Members unlock partner perks at manga stores, food spots, and hobby retailers across Sydney, as well as prizes and food/drink supplied for events!
discordOverview: Discord is our command center for announcements, reminders, signups, and daily anime discussion between on-campus events.

membershipSteps.label: AnimeUNSW Membership
membershipSteps.summary: Join the society from home or at an event!

tabs.label: Join at home
steps: Open the Rubric app or website
Complete the online membership form and payment
Show an exec your Rubric app or web to prove membership, and receive your physical membership card

tabs.label: Join at an event
steps: Decide whether to pay cash or card, and ask an exec for the relevant QR code
Pay membership fee by your preferred method
Collect your membership card from an exec on-site
